candidate_windows.window_text: We have noted that the ChatGPT is continuously evolving. Furthermore, we have conducted supplementary experiments on three datasets using the latest August version of LLM. The results are presented in the Table 4. It is noteworthy that ChatGPT indeed continuously evolves, as evidenced by its distinct performance compared to that of the June version. Although the evolved ChatGPT underperforms compared to the June version on the WTQ dataset, our approach can consistently further enhances the ChatGPT performance with the evolved version on all three tasks. It indicates the robustness of our proposed method.
